# mirror-leech-telegram-bot-fuse

> Open-source Telegram mirror and leech bot (Python 3.12+, Docker, GPL-3.0) that mounts archives with Linux FUSE (archivemount, readonly,nosave) instead of extracting them, offers an inline Telegram ZIP picker, and uploads through a TDLib multi-session pool to Telegram, Google Drive or Rclone. A fork-derived project by MHJoy99 built on python-aria-mirror-bot and anasty17/mirror-leech-telegram-bot.

Key facts: a Linux host with /dev/fuse and Docker Engine 24+ / Compose v2 is required; the FUSE container needs cap_add SYS_ADMIN. Version 2.0.0 (CITATION.cff). Benchmarks on the site are author-reported README figures, not independently verified. Use responsibly: respect the terms of service of Telegram, Google Drive and every service you use, and applicable law.
